name: com.unity.addressables
description:
The Addressables package provides a user interface in the Unity Editor to organize and manage the assets in your project, to create content builds that you can ship along with a Player build. It also has an API that you can use to load and release assets at runtime.

The Addressables package was originally designed on top of Unity's AssetBundle system, but is also compatible with the newer content directories system. Addressables automatically manages dependencies, asset locations, and provides simpler workflows for memory management which you otherwise have to handle manually in the AssetBundle and content directories systems.

When you make an asset Addressable, you can use that asset's address to load it locally or from a content delivery network, rather than using its file name, AssetBundle location, or content directory location. This means you can change the location of assets in a project without needing to rewrite code.

samples.description: This sample contains a set of utility functions for Addressables.
This sample creates an AssetReference that is restricted to having a specific Component. See the ComponentReference sample project located at github.com/Unity-Technologies/Addressables-Sample

This sample shows how to create custom AnalyzeRules for use within the Analyze window. Both rules follow the recommended pattern for adding themselves to the UI. See the Custom Analyze Rules sample project located at github.com/Unity-Technologies/Addressables-Sample
Example custom build and play mode scripts provided.  Along with a README discussing how to add them to the Addressables system.
A script that disables asset importing during a player build.  This improves build performance since AssetBundles are copied into StreamingAssets at build time.
A tool that imports group assets (for example from a custom package) to the current project.
A basic script that instantiates and destroys a prefab AssetReference.

_upm.changelog:
- Fixed the build profile recording empty building and generating steps for schema builders with no work to do.
- Fixed the Addressables Report summary showing "NaN%" when a build has no assets.
- Fixed the "View by" dropdown in the Addressables Report window overlapping the search field when the window is narrow.
- Fixed AssetReference values in a serialized Dictionary appearing empty and uneditable in the Inspector.
